Nothing to do with the sustain pedal, just play the notes as legato. Only add the pedal if it indicates. However sometimes the piece does not indicate any pedal so it’s up to the player to decide how to play it. I generally only play legato notes with sustain pedal however I have had pieces that say use the pedal with staccato notes

Please don’t letter the keys if it is a ‘real’ piano standup/grand too much money just to write on however if you need to memorise the letter notes just use the 2,3 pattern. 
The first note before the 2 black notes is C, the last is E. And with the 3 black notes, the white key before the 1st black key is F and the last is B now from there just fill in the remainder of the letters and when playing remember that pattern
Paul Harris improve your sight reading. There is book for every level and I believe it’s one of the best. It starts easy and progresses while teaching you different methods to speed up.
